texts.preamble: Lal Mohammad vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 August, 2022 High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Court No. - 84 Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 23261 of 2022 Applicant :- Lal Mohammad Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Sudhir Dixit,Anupam Shyam Dwivedi,Smt. Richa Dixita Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A. Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J. When the case is called out, Sri Sudhir Dixit, learned counsel for the applicant submits that the instant application has been filed against the order dated 30.06.2021 passed by Adjudicating Officer/Additional District Magistrate (City), Aligarh in Complaint Case No. 01783 of 2019, under Sections 3(1)(zx), 26(1)(2)(ii), 51 and 58 Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 and against the impugned order, an appeal is maintainable under Section 70 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, therefore, instant application may be dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file an appeal before the appropriate forum.
